title: The Fastest Way to Make Money With AI: Stop Losing It
style: Read this like a funny, honest, energetic friend in a quick social video. Playful on the joke, then clear and practical.

segments.title: The fastest AI money move? Stop losing it.
segments.say: Here's the fastest way to make money with AI that nobody talks about. Stop losing it.

segments.title: One small business: about $480 a month saved
bullets: Paused weak ads, cancelled an unused tool
segments.say: A small installation business listed every subscription and every ad it was paying for, and asked AI which ones were actually worth it. It paused ads that brought very few customers and cancelled a tool nobody used. That's about four hundred eighty dollars a month back. Your numbers will be different, but you can do this tonight.

chat.user: Here are my monthly costs: [list with prices]. Here's what each one brought in: [results]. Which should I keep, cut or test?
chat.ai:
Keep: your scheduling app (used daily).
Cut: the design tool, not used in 3 months.
Test: pause the ads for 2 weeks and watch how many calls you lose.
